data.narrative:
Rune Technologies is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by David Tuttle and Peter Goldsborough, having raised $20M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates against a universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers, comprising 2 public and 8 private companies including Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total raised ($20M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for Series A advancement, implies $40M. The peer-median method calculates the median valuation across 10 Defense & Security comparables at $1.0B, with a observed range of $125M–$3.0B. Sample peers include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), most at Series B stage.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median point of $520M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriateness of peer multiples and the absence of comparable recent Series A transactions in the sector. The peer-median methodology carries greater weight given the size and homogeneity of the comparison set; however, the stage-progression floor provides downside discipline. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation within the peer set and market timing relative to Defense & Security funding cycles.
